cards.title: Production Builds
cards.content:
Building the App

Before deploying, you must compile your Angular application. Running ng build generates optimized, minified, and tree-shaken static files in the dist/ directory.

By default, ng build uses the production configuration in newer Angular versions.

cards.title: Environment Variables
cards.content:
Environments

Angular environments allow you to configure different variables (like API URLs) for development and production. You can configure file replacements in angular.json.

// environment.ts
export const environment = {
  production: false,
  apiUrl: 'http://localhost:3000'
};

cards.title: Hosting Providers
cards.content:
Where to Deploy

Since a standard Angular build is just static HTML, CSS, and JS, it can be hosted anywhere.

  • Firebase Hosting: ng deploy with @angular/fire
  • Vercel / Netlify: Automatic deployments from GitHub
  • Docker: Containerize your app with NGINX
